issues.description: The discharge summary gives a different surgery date than the operative report. Which date is correct?
A 14-day enoxaparin course was planned, but the discharge medication list stops enoxaparin and lists aspirin. Is the reason for the change documented?
Calf swelling was reported to the therapist on 2024-07-30, and emergency evaluation took place on 2024-08-02. What happened in between?
The therapist documents a message left with the orthopedic office, but the production has no orthopedic telephone note or call log for that date. Request the office phone records.
